transcript: This AI tool will help you save more than 10,000 rupees a month. I just found out that I've been losing money on my credit cards every single month. So last week I did something I tell my clients to do and never do myself. I actually audited my own spends. Turns out I've got three cards and I use whichever one's on top of my wallet. Dining out, wrong card. Flight booking last month, wrong card. Gym supplements, wrong card. Fir ek din maasi ne bataya that I should use CheQ's Wisor, it's an AI credit expert and I asked it just one thing: How much did I save by optimizing my rewards this month? It didn't just tell me yes or no, it went transaction by transaction and told me exactly which card I should have used instead and the exact rupees I left on the table for each one of them. That is the kind of audit I charge a client lakhs to build and it's sitting right inside an app most people only open to pay their bills and close. I build complex systems for a living, but I still needed AI to catch my own mistake. Just comment money and I'll send the tool link to you inside your DMs right away. Ciao. I'll see you in the next one.
